name: booking-simulator
description: PostgreSQL concurrent movie booking simulator and real-time web app

scripts.dev: concurrently --names api,web --prefix-colors yellow,cyan "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm run build:cli && npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
